New source-indicated unauthenticated balance GET returned 404 and no financial data; no sibling order/trade mutation requests followed.
One random invalid auth-code exchange returned HTTP 400 with errorType invalid_ac; no session_token was issued or used.
A public timestamp control through the source-indicated xbff proxy returned 403 API route not in whitelist; no sensitive route followed.
One public-control literal dot-segment differential encountered Cloudflare 403; no encoded variants, challenge bypass, or sensitive path expansion followed.
Source-indicated NextAuth session path returned 404; no user session or API key was observed.

No usable production AWS key, JWT, private key, bearer token, password, or API credential was verified in extracted Titan sources. Secret-like upload values were non-credential placeholders; Accounts cryptography remained client-side key handling without demonstrated decryption impact.
